summary: Verified the current served-source implementation of Prometeo Live v3 against the mobile human-registry contract. Source-level evidence confirms the narrow-layout safeguards, horizontal snap/swipe rail, static feed consumption, 6m suspect / 10m replaceable policy, today/open-worker split, tappable prior-day history, Inbox short IDs + human text, and Projects/Production tabs. One acceptance defect is exact: portfolio inspection in build-live-feed retains full pins/claims/collisions, but the published projects projection strips those arrays and the mobile active detail renders only collision_count/worker metadata, so a contended task cannot expose meaningful winner pin generation / collision / recovery lineage as required. A bounded repair successor was materialized. Runtime browser/narrow-viewport execution was not independently available in this worker environment, so visual no-overflow remains source-verified rather than browser-verified.
tests: STATIC_LAYOUT: html/body max-width 100% + overflow-x hidden; app <=520px; rail/view min-width and 100% snap layout; mobile <=350px overrides present.
LIVENESS_POLICY: mobile.js defaults and feed thresholds both encode stale suspect=6m, recovery/replaceable=10m, allocation silent=3m.
SWIPE_NAV: four views share horizontal rail with scroll-snap; tab buttons scroll target views and rail scroll updates selected tab.
HISTORY: current day excluded from prior-day bars; bars are tappable and expand durable worker detail.
INBOX: static feed message_id + text are rendered; unread count stored locally.
STATIC_DATA_SOURCE: browser fetches ./feed.json and ./pages.json; no GitHub API traversal found in served mobile/page scripts.
PIN_LINEAGE_NEGATIVE: build-live-feed retains pins/claims/collisions internally but strips them from projects output; activeCard exposes only collision count, not compact winner/recovery lineage.
unresolved: Actual narrow-viewport browser rendering/gesture execution was not independently exercised by this worker; no Served/Human Accepted claim is made from static source checks.
Meaningful compact PIN/collision/recovery lineage in expanded task detail is not satisfied by current served source and requires the derived repair job.
